content.bridge_context: Understanding the physical and organizational structures needed for society to function.

units.title: What is Infrastructure?
units.explanation: Basic systems like roads, power, water supply, schools, and hospitals.
units.dual_language_instruction: List three infrastructure projects in your city. / अपने शहर में तीन बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं की सूची बनाएं।

units.title: Transport and Communication
units.explanation: Means to move people/goods and exchange information.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name the fastest mode of transport. / परिवहन के सबसे तेज़ साधन का नाम बताएं।
